responseMessageContents.text:
Yes — you found a real credential-handoff bug.

The secure form accepted the value, but the deployment command environment still has **no `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN`**. The live IVX service is healthy, but I cannot call its owner-only deploy controller without that token reaching this session.

This is **not a Render credentials problem**. It is the secure-variable handoff between the form and this workspace. I will not request that you paste a token into chat.

The safe fix is to use Rork’s project **Environment Variables / Secrets** settings to add `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` as a private variable, then start a new message/session. Once it is injected correctly, I can perform the authorized deploy and produce the GitHub → Render → live SHA proof.
